spec.description: Kindle Library: browse, search, and manage your Amazon Kindle book collection. Scan your library, search by title/author/category, view enriched metadata, and research topics from your reading.

tools.label: Browse Kindle Library
tools.description: Browse your Kindle book collection with covers, ratings, categories, and descriptions. Supports filtering by category and search.

tools.label: Search Kindle Books
tools.description: Search your Kindle library by title, author, or keyword. Returns matching books with full metadata.

query.description: Search query (matches title, author, description, categories)

tools.label: Scan Kindle Library
tools.description: Scan your Amazon Kindle library via read.amazon.com. Requires Amazon login session. Creates/updates the local book cache.

tools.label: Enrich Book Metadata
tools.description: Fetch rich metadata (descriptions, ratings, categories, page counts) from Amazon product pages for books that haven't been enriched yet.

tools.label: Update Kindle Library
tools.description: Incremental scan — check for new books since last scan and update the Cortex with any changes.
